---
title: "aanvi_q3_graphs"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
# loading in data
sal <- read_csv(paste0(
  "https://stat.cmu.edu/~sgallagh/courses/mads-fall-2026/",
  "datavis-36613/data/salaries.csv.gz"
))

sal$experience_level <- factor(
  sal$experience_level,
  levels = c("EX", "SE", "MI", "EN"),
  labels = c("Executive", "Senior", "Mid", "Entry")
)
```

```{r}
# labeling remote variable
sal <- sal |> 
  mutate(
    remote = case_when(
      remote_ratio == 0 ~ "On-Site",
      remote_ratio == 50 ~ "Hybrid",
      remote_ratio == 100 ~ "Fully remote"
    ), 
    remote = factor(
      remote, levels = c("On-Site", "Hybrid", "Fully remote")
    )
  )


# boxplot of salary by work arrangement
ggplot(
  sal,
  aes(x = remote, y = salary_in_usd)
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Work arrangement",
    y = "Annual salary (USD)",
    title = "Salary distributions by work arrangement"
  ) + theme_classic()
```

```{r}
ggplot(sal, aes(x = remote, y = salary_in_usd)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ experience_level) +
  labs(
    x = "Work arrangement",
    y = "Annual salary (USD)",
    title = "Salary by work arrangement within experience level"
  ) + theme_classic()
```

```{r}
# ggplot(sal, aes(x = salary_in_usd, fill = remote)) +
#   geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +

ggplot(
  sal,
  aes(x = salary_in_usd, fill = remote)
) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ experience_level) +
  labs(
    x = "Annual salary (USD)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Work arrangement",
    title = "Salary distributions by work arrangement and experience"
  ) + theme_classic()
```
